title: IoT Dashboard
content: Apply IoT dashboard aesthetic with connected device feel. Sensor reading gauges and displays. Device status cards with online/offline indicators. Temperature, humidity, motion data visualization. Smart home control switches. Automation rule builders. Device pairing interfaces. Firmware update progress. Battery level indicators. Location-based device maps. Alert and notification panels.

variants.simple: Create IoT dashboard with sensor readings, device status, and smart home controls.
variants.detailed: Apply IoT dashboard aesthetic with connected device feel. Sensor reading gauges and displays. Device status cards with online/offline indicators. Temperature, humidity, motion data visualization. Smart home control switches. Automation rule builders. Device pairing interfaces. Firmware update progress. Battery level indicators. Location-based device maps. Alert and notification panels.
variants.advanced: Apply IoT aesthetic with smart device dashboard patterns. Sensor gauges: circular for temp/humidity, linear for levels. Device cards with MAC address, firmware version, last seen. Real-time charts for sensor time-series. Toggle switches for smart controls with state sync. Automation flows with trigger→condition→action. Device discovery lists with pairing buttons. OTA update progress bars. Battery icons with percentage (full→critical colors). Floor plan SVG with device markers. Push notification cards with device source. MQTT connection status indicators.
